title: Pakistan Poverty Rate Climbs to 29% Amid Job Shortages
excerpt: Pakistan's poverty rate has increased from 22 percent to 29 percent because job creation has failed to keep pace.
body_html:
Pakistan has experienced a significant increase in its poverty rate, which has climbed from 22 percent to 29 percent.

According to the available details, this rise in poverty is primarily driven by the country's inability to generate enough employment opportunities. Job creation has struggled to keep pace with the needs of the population, leading to the worsening economic conditions reflected in the updated figures.
